il.what: compiler scheduling (level 4): q_norm and kv_norm sub-chains interleaved; kv row copy designed out (scaling writes the output row, RoPE rotates its tail in place)

dr.what: hc_post's chained sum of squares dropped: no SU consumer; the mixes' engine ot_hdc_v41x_hcp (cmd_scale 1) computes ss = csum(flat*flat) itself, concurrently with its rows (Model.hc_mixes)
dr.verdict: ADOPT (exact; hc_mixes stays the baseline's off-path model term)

ov.what: attention softmax pipelined with the tile: max + exp (P written) before p.v; sum, sink exp, denominator under the tile's p.v phase (361 fast cycles at T640, checked: den written 279 <= 191 + 271); normalise + inverse RoPE after p.v measured as its own case (91 cycles P1, 116 P6)
ov.chain: attend T640 SU critical P1 367 -> 282, P6 392 -> 332 (T128 not eligible: p.v phase 105 fast cycles < denominator lag, kept at 347)

kr.what: lane-local fusion, the ROM's W11 build ot_hdc_v41x_vec_kr / _vec_lane_kr KR_DEPTH 40 + tools/w11_su_fuse.fuse_bench: dependent element hops through lane registers
kr.hardware: KR 40 x 32 b per lane (+834 um2 light lane, +824 um2 SFU lane pre-layout)
kr.chain: per fused hop -7 cycles: hc_post P1 167 -> 146, hc_pre_norm 314 -> 305; P6 (op-major, throughput-bound) no gain, not used there
kr.verdict: ADOPT for AR, conditional on the closure program's route (lane screen: KR adds no new critical path)

floors.hc_post: 4 dependent passes are the golden order ((r0c0 + r1c1) + r2c2) + r3c3 + y*post (one op takes at most 2 products); P1 = 4 x hop (31, 24 with KR) + 20 vectors; P6 = throughput 480 vectors at N1024 (288 at N2048) + one depth: at floor for the lane width
floors.hc_pre_norm / final_norm: 3 element hops + chunk8 reduction tail (57) + scalar div/add/rsqrt (95) + scale (34): every term mandatory; KR removes 9 cycles; floor
floors.q_norm_kv_row: two independent norms overlapped: ss reduction (86) + rsqrt (95) + scale (34) + pair RoPE (34); floor
floors.attend: max (82) -> exp (P written 191) -> [tile p.v] -> divide (49) + inverse RoPE (34); sum/sink/den hidden; floor
floors.router_act / swiglu / route / moe_sum /: one SFU or reduction op (or 2-4 dependent scalar ops), depth-bound by the function's pipeline; unchanged; floor
floors.beyond the floor (not taken): every op crosses all lane stages (linear depth 25 at MLAT4/ALAT3) even when M2/E1/E2 are bypassed; a stage-skipping lane would cut ~10 cycles per dependent op, but it changes the SU shared with the ROM accelerator, so it belongs to both designs or neither (fairness)

exactness.rule: every chain's outputs equal the executor's golden-checked values word for word (checks in each su record); unit reference PASS; FP stand-in equivalence RTL vs DPI at N64
exactness.n_chain_runs_exact: all rows exact=True in every su record
